verses.original: Ὁ οὖν Ἰησοῦς πρὸ ἓξ ἡμερῶν τοῦ πάσχα ἦλθεν εἰς Βηθανίαν ὅπου ἦν Λάζαρος ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: Ho oun Iēsous pro hex hēmerōn tou pascha ēlthen eis Bēthanian hopou ēn Lazaros hon ēgeiren ek nekrōn Iēsous
verses.literal: Six days before the Passover Jesus came to Bethany the hometown of . . . Lazarus whom He had raised from the dead
verses.literalPt: Seis dias antes da Páscoa, foi Jesus a Betânia, onde estava Lázaro, a quem ele ressuscitou dentre os mortos.

verses.original: ἐποίησαν οὖν αὐτῷ δεῖπνον ἐκεῖ καὶ ἡ Μάρθα διηκόνει ὁ δὲ Λάζαρος εἷς ἦν ἐκ τῶν ἀνακειμένων σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: epoiēsan oun autō deipnon ekei kai hē Martha diēkonei ho de Lazaros heis ēn ek tōn anakeimenōn syn autō
verses.literal: So they hosted a dinner for Jesus there - Martha served and Lazarus was among . . . those reclining at the table with Him
verses.literalPt: Deram-lhe aí uma ceia, e nela Marta servia, e Lázaro era um dos que estavam à mesa com ele.

verses.original: ἡ οὖν Μαριὰμ λαβοῦσα λίτραν μύρου νάρδου πιστικῆς πολυτίμου ἤλειψεν τοὺς πόδας τοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ ἐξέμαξεν ταῖς θριξὶν αὐτῆς τοὺς πόδας αὐτοῦ ἡ δὲ οἰκία ἐπληρώθη ἐκ τῆς ὀσμῆς τοῦ μύρου
verses.transliteration: hē oun Mariam labousa litran myrou nardou pistikēs polytimou ēleipsen tous podas tou Iēsou kai exemaxen tais thrixin autēs tous podas autou hē de oikia eplērōthē ek tēs osmēs tou myrou
verses.literal: Then Mary took about a pint of expensive perfume made of pure nard and she anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped them with her hair And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume
verses.literalPt: Então, Maria, tomando uma libra de perfume de nardo puro, mui precioso, ungiu os pés de Jesus e enxugou-os com os seus cabelos; e a casa encheu-se do cheiro do perfume.

verses.original: Λέγει δὲ Ἰούδας ὁ Ἰσκαριώτης εἷς ἐκ τῶν μαθητῶν αὐτοῦ ὁ μέλλων αὐτὸν παραδιδόναι
verses.transliteration: Legei de Ioudas ho Iskariōtēs heis ek tōn mathētōn autou ho mellōn auton paradidonai
verses.literal: But one of His disciples Judas Iscariot who was going to betray Him asked
verses.literalPt: Judas Iscariotes, um de seus discípulos, aquele que o havia de trair, perguntou:

verses.original: Διὰ τί τοῦτο τὸ μύρον οὐκ ἐπράθη τριακοσίων δηναρίων καὶ ἐδόθη πτωχοῖς
verses.transliteration: Dia ti touto to myron ouk eprathē triakosiōn dēnariōn kai edothē ptōchois
verses.literal: Why . . . wasn’t this perfume sold for three hundred denarii and the money given to the poor
verses.literalPt: Por que não se vendeu este perfume por trezentos denários e não se deu aos pobres?

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ τοῦτο οὐχ ὅτι περὶ τῶν πτωχῶν ἔμελεν αὐτῷ ἀλλ’ ὅτι κλέπτης ἦν καὶ τὸ γλωσσόκομον ἔχων τὰ βαλλόμενα ἐβάσταζεν
verses.transliteration: eipen de touto ouch hoti peri tōn ptōchōn emelen autō all’ hoti kleptēs ēn kai to glōssokomon echōn ta ballomena ebastazen
verses.literal: Judas did not say . . . this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief As keeper of the money bag he used to take from what was put into it
verses.literalPt: Isso disse ele, não porque cuidasse dos pobres, mas porque era ladrão e, tendo a bolsa, subtraía o que nela se deitava.

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἄφες αὐτήν ἵνα εἰς τὴν ἡμέραν τοῦ ἐνταφιασμοῦ μου τηρήσῃ αὐτό
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun ho Iēsous Aphes autēn hina eis tēn hēmeran tou entaphiasmou mou tērēsē auto
verses.literal: Leave her alone . . . - Jesus replied She has kept this perfume in preparation for the day of My burial
verses.literalPt: Respondeu Jesus: Deixai-a, a fim de que guarde isso para o dia da minha sepultura;

verses.original: τοὺς πτωχοὺς γὰρ πάντοτε ἔχετε μεθ’ ἑαυτῶν ἐμὲ δὲ οὐ πάντοτε ἔχετε
verses.transliteration: tous ptōchous gar pantote echete meth’ heautōn eme de ou pantote echete
verses.literal: The poor you will always have . . . with you but you will not always have Me
verses.literalPt: porque os pobres, sempre os tendes convosco, mas a mim nem sempre me tendes.

verses.original: Ἔγνω οὖν ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ἐκ τῶν Ἰουδαίων ὅτι ἐκεῖ ἐστιν καὶ ἦλθον οὐ διὰ τὸν Ἰησοῦν μόνον ἀλλ’ ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἴδωσιν ὃν ἤγειρεν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Egnō oun ho ochlos polys ek tōn Ioudaiōn hoti ekei estin kai ēlthon ou dia ton Iēsoun monon all’ hina kai ton Lazaron idōsin hon ēgeiren ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews learned that Jesus was there And they came not only because of Him but also to see Lazarus whom He had raised from the dead
verses.literalPt: Soube uma grande multidão dos judeus que Jesus estava ali, e foram lá não somente por causa dele, mas também para verem a Lázaro, a quem ele ressuscitara dentre os mortos.

verses.original: ἐβουλεύσαντο δὲ οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς ἵνα καὶ τὸν Λάζαρον ἀποκτείνωσιν
verses.transliteration: ebouleusanto de hoi archiereis hina kai ton Lazaron apokteinōsin
verses.literal: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well
verses.literalPt: Mas os principais sacerdotes resolveram também tirar a vida a Lázaro,

verses.original: ὅτι πολλοὶ δι’ αὐτὸν ὑπῆγον τῶν Ἰουδαίων καὶ ἐπίστευον εἰς τὸν Ἰησοῦν
verses.transliteration: hoti polloi di’ auton hypēgon tōn Ioudaiōn kai episteuon eis ton Iēsoun
verses.literal: for on account of him many of the Jews were deserting them and believing in Jesus
verses.literalPt: pois muitos judeus, por causa dele, se retiravam e criam em Jesus.

verses.original: Τῇ ἐπαύριον ὁ ὄχλος πολὺς ὁ ἐλθὼν εἰς τὴν ἑορτήν ἀκούσαντες ὅτι ἔρχεται ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἰς Ἱεροσόλυμα
verses.transliteration: Tē epaurion ho ochlos polys ho elthōn eis tēn heortēn akousantes hoti erchetai ho Iēsous eis Hierosolyma
verses.literal: The next day the great crowd that had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem
verses.literalPt: No dia seguinte, uma grande multidão que tinha vindo à festa, sabendo que Jesus vinha a Jerusalém,

verses.original: ἔλαβον τὰ βαΐα τῶν φοινίκων καὶ ἐξῆλθον εἰς ὑπάντησιν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐκραύγαζον Ὡσαννά Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου Καὶ ὁ Βασιλεὺς τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: elabon ta baia tōn phoinikōn kai exēlthon eis hypantēsin autō kai ekraugazon Hōsanna Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou Kai ho Basileus tou Israēl
verses.literal: They took - palm branches and went out to meet Him shouting Hosanna Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord Blessed is the King of Israel
verses.literalPt: tomaram ramos de palmeiras e saíram ao seu encontro, clamando: Hosana! Bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor! Bendito o Rei de Israel!

verses.original: Εὑρὼν δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ὀνάριον ἐκάθισεν ἐπ’ αὐτό καθώς ἐστιν γεγραμμένον
verses.transliteration: Heurōn de ho Iēsous onarion ekathisen ep’ auto kathōs estin gegrammenon
verses.literal: Finding a young donkey Jesus sat on it as it is written
verses.literalPt: Jesus, tendo achado um jumentinho, montou nele, segundo está escrito:

verses.original: Μὴ φοβοῦ θυγάτηρ Σιών ἰδοὺ ὁ Βασιλεύς σου ἔρχεται καθήμενος ἐπὶ πῶλον ὄνου
verses.transliteration: Mē phobou thygatēr Siōn idou ho Basileus sou erchetai kathēmenos epi pōlon onou
verses.literal: Do not be afraid . . . O Daughter of Zion See your King is coming seated on the colt of a donkey
verses.literalPt: Não temas, filha de Sião, eis que vem o teu Rei, montado em um filho de jumenta.

verses.original: Ταῦτα οὐκ ἔγνωσαν αὐτοῦ οἱ μαθηταὶ τὸ πρῶτον ἀλλ’ ὅτε ἐδοξάσθη Ἰησοῦς τότε ἐμνήσθησαν ὅτι ταῦτα ἦν ἐπ’ αὐτῷ γεγραμμένα καὶ ταῦτα ἐποίησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Tauta ouk egnōsan autou hoi mathētai to prōton all’ hote edoxasthē Iēsous tote emnēsthēsan hoti tauta ēn ep’ autō gegrammena kai tauta epoiēsan autō
verses.literal: At first His disciples did not understand these things but after Jesus was glorified they remembered what had been done to Him and they realized that these very things had also been written about Him
verses.literalPt: Seus discípulos, a princípio, não compreenderam tudo isso; mas, quando Jesus foi glorificado, então, se lembraram de que isso estava escrito a respeito dele e de que assim lhe fizeram.

verses.original: Ἐμαρτύρει οὖν ὁ ὄχλος ὁ ὢν μετ’ αὐτοῦ ὅτε τὸν Λάζαρον ἐφώνησεν ἐκ τοῦ μνημείου καὶ ἤγειρεν αὐτὸν ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Emartyrei oun ho ochlos ho ōn met’ autou hote ton Lazaron ephōnēsen ek tou mnēmeiou kai ēgeiren auton ek nekrōn
verses.literal: Meanwhile many people who had been with Jesus when He called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to testify
verses.literalPt: A multidão que estava com ele, quando chamara a Lázaro do túmulo e o levantara dentre os mortos, dava testemunho.

verses.original: διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ὑπήντησεν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι ἤκουσαν τοῦτο αὐτὸν πεποιηκέναι τὸ σημεῖον
verses.transliteration: dia touto kai hypēntēsen autō ho ochlos hoti ēkousan touto auton pepoiēkenai to sēmeion
verses.literal: That is also why . . . . . . the crowd went out to meet Him because they heard that He had performed this sign
verses.literalPt: Por isso, também a multidão lhe saiu ao encontro, porque souberam que ele tinha feito esse milagre.

verses.original: Οἱ οὖν Φαρισαῖοι εἶπαν πρὸς ἑαυτούς Θεωρεῖτε ὅτι οὐκ ὠφελεῖτε οὐδέν ἴδε ὁ κόσμος ὀπίσω αὐτοῦ ἀπῆλθεν
verses.transliteration: Hoi oun Pharisaioi eipan pros heautous Theōreite hoti ouk ōpheleite ouden ide ho kosmos opisō autou apēlthen
verses.literal: Then the Pharisees said to one another You can see that this is doing you no good . . . . . . Look how the whole world has gone after Him
verses.literalPt: De sorte que os fariseus disseram entre si: Vedes que nada conseguis; eis aí após ele foi todo o mundo.

verses.original: Ἦσαν δὲ Ἕλληνές τινες ἐκ τῶν ἀναβαινόντων ἵνα προσκυνήσωσιν ἐν τῇ ἑορτῇ
verses.transliteration: Ēsan de Hellēnes tines ek tōn anabainontōn hina proskynēsōsin en tē heortē
verses.literal: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast
verses.literalPt: Entre os que tinham ido para adorar na festa, havia alguns gregos;

verses.original: οὗτοι οὖν προσῆλθον Φιλίππῳ τῷ ἀπὸ Βηθσαϊδὰ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ ἠρώτων αὐτὸν λέγοντες Κύριε θέλομεν τὸν Ἰησοῦν ἰδεῖν
verses.transliteration: houtoi oun prosēlthon Philippō tō apo Bēthsaida tēs Galilaias kai ērōtōn auton legontes Kyrie thelomen ton Iēsoun idein
verses.literal: They came to Philip who was from Bethsaida in Galilee and requested of him . . . Sir we want to see Jesus
verses.literalPt: estes, pois, foram ter com Filipe, que era de Betsaida da Galileia, e lhe fizeram este pedido: Senhor, queremos ver a Jesus.

verses.original: ἔρχεται ὁ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγει τῷ Ἀνδρέᾳ ἔρχεται Ἀνδρέας καὶ Φίλιππος καὶ λέγουσιν τῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: erchetai ho Philippos kai legei tō Andrea erchetai Andreas kai Philippos kai legousin tō Iēsou
verses.literal: Philip - relayed this appeal to Andrew and both of them . . . . . . went and told Jesus
verses.literalPt: Filipe foi dizê-lo a André, e André e Filipe foram-no dizer a Jesus.

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ Ἰησοῦς ἀποκρίνεται αὐτοῖς λέγων Ἐλήλυθεν ἡ ὥρα ἵνα δοξασθῇ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Ho de Iēsous apokrinetai autois legōn Elēlythen hē hōra hina doxasthē ho Huios tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: But Jesus replied . . . . . . The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified
verses.literalPt: Disse-lhes Jesus: É chegada a hora de ser glorificado o Filho do Homem.

verses.original: ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἐὰν μὴ ὁ κόκκος τοῦ σίτου πεσὼν εἰς τὴν γῆν ἀποθάνῃ αὐτὸς μόνος μένει ἐὰν δὲ ἀποθάνῃ πολὺν καρπὸν φέρει
verses.transliteration: amēn amēn legō hymin ean mē ho kokkos tou sitou pesōn eis tēn gēn apothanē autos monos menei ean de apothanē polyn karpon pherei
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you unless . . . a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies it remains only a seed But if it dies it bears much fruit
verses.literalPt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: se o grão de trigo, caindo na terra, não morrer, fica só; mas, se morrer, dá muito fruto.

verses.original: ὁ φιλῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἀπολλύει αὐτήν καὶ ὁ μισῶν τὴν ψυχὴν αὐτοῦ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ τούτῳ εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον φυλάξει αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: ho philōn tēn psychēn autou apollyei autēn kai ho misōn tēn psychēn autou en tō kosmō toutō eis zōēn aiōnion phylaxei autēn
verses.literal: Whoever loves his life will lose it but whoever hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life
verses.literalPt: Quem ama a sua vida perdê-la-á; mas quem aborrece a sua vida neste mundo conservá-la-á para a vida eterna.

verses.original: ἐὰν ἐμοί τις διακονῇ ἐμοὶ ἀκολουθείτω καὶ ὅπου εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ἐκεῖ καὶ ὁ διάκονος ὁ ἐμὸς ἔσται ἐάν τις ἐμοὶ διακονῇ τιμήσει αὐτὸν ὁ Πατήρ
verses.transliteration: ean emoi tis diakonē emoi akoloutheitō kai hopou eimi egō ekei kai ho diakonos ho emos estai ean tis emoi diakonē timēsei auton ho Patēr
verses.literal: If anyone serves Me he must follow Me and where I am - My servant will be as well If anyone serves Me the Father will honor him
verses.literalPt: Se alguém me servir, siga-me, e, onde eu estou, estará aquele que me serve; se alguém me servir, o Pai o honrará.

verses.original: Νῦν ἡ ψυχή μου τετάρακται καὶ τί εἴπω Πάτερ σῶσόν με ἐκ τῆς ὥρας ταύτης ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ὥραν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: Nyn hē psychē mou tetaraktai kai ti eipō Pater sōson me ek tēs hōras tautēs alla dia touto ēlthon eis tēn hōran tautēn
verses.literal: Now My soul is troubled and what shall I say Father save Me from this hour No it is for this purpose . . . that I have come to this hour
verses.literalPt: Agora, está perturbada a minha alma, e que direi? Pai, livra-me desta hora. Mas para isso foi que vim a esta hora.

verses.original: Πάτερ δόξασόν σου τὸ ὄνομα Ἦλθεν οὖν φωνὴ ἐκ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ Καὶ ἐδόξασα καὶ πάλιν δοξάσω
verses.transliteration: Pater doxason sou to onoma Ēlthen oun phōnē ek tou ouranou Kai edoxasa kai palin doxasō
verses.literal: Father glorify Your name Then a voice came from heaven I have glorified it and I will glorify it again
verses.literalPt: Pai, glorifica o teu nome. Veio, então, do céu esta voz: Eu já o glorifiquei e outra vez o glorificarei.

verses.original: Ὁ οὖν ὄχλος ὁ ἑστὼς καὶ ἀκούσας ἔλεγεν Βροντὴν γεγονέναι ἄλλοι ἔλεγον Ἄγγελος αὐτῷ λελάληκεν
verses.transliteration: Ho oun ochlos ho hestōs kai akousas elegen Brontēn gegonenai alloi elegon Angelos autō lelalēken
verses.literal: The crowd standing there heard it and said that it had thundered Others said that an angel had spoken to Him
verses.literalPt: A multidão, pois, que ali estava e a ouvira, dizia ter havido um trovão; outros diziam que um anjo lhe falara.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη Ἰησοῦς καὶ εἶπεν Οὐ δι’ ἐμὲ ἡ φωνὴ αὕτη γέγονεν ἀλλὰ δι’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē Iēsous kai eipen Ou di’ eme hē phōnē hautē gegonen alla di’ hymas
verses.literal: In response . . . Jesus said This voice was not for My benefit . . . but yours
verses.literalPt: Disse Jesus: Não foi por minha causa, mas sim por vossa causa que veio esta voz.

verses.original: νῦν κρίσις ἐστὶν τοῦ κόσμου τούτου νῦν ὁ ἄρχων τοῦ κόσμου τούτου ἐκβληθήσεται ἔξω
verses.transliteration: nyn krisis estin tou kosmou toutou nyn ho archōn tou kosmou toutou ekblēthēsetai exō
verses.literal: Now judgment is upon this world now the prince of this world will be cast out
verses.literalPt: Agora, é o juízo deste mundo; agora, será expulso o príncipe deste mundo;

verses.original: κἀγὼ ἐὰν ὑψωθῶ ἐκ τῆς γῆς πάντας ἑλκύσω πρὸς ἐμαυτόν
verses.transliteration: kagō ean hypsōthō ek tēs gēs pantas helkysō pros emauton
verses.literal: And I when I am lifted up from the earth will draw everyone to Myself
verses.literalPt: e eu, quando for levantado da terra, atrairei todos a mim.

verses.original: τοῦτο δὲ ἔλεγεν σημαίνων ποίῳ θανάτῳ ἤμελλεν ἀποθνήσκειν
verses.transliteration: touto de elegen sēmainōn poiō thanatō ēmellen apothnēskein
verses.literal: He said this to indicate the kind of death He was going to die
verses.literalPt: Isso dizia, dando a entender o modo por que havia de morrer.

verses.original: Ἀπεκρίθη οὖν αὐτῷ ὁ ὄχλος Ἡμεῖς ἠκούσαμεν ἐκ τοῦ νόμου ὅτι ὁ Χριστὸς μένει εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα καὶ πῶς λέγεις σὺ ὅτι δεῖ ὑψωθῆναι τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου τίς ἐστιν οὗτος ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου
verses.transliteration: Apekrithē oun autō ho ochlos Hēmeis ēkousamen ek tou nomou hoti ho Christos menei eis ton aiōna kai pōs legeis sy hoti dei hypsōthēnai ton Huion tou anthrōpou tis estin houtos ho Huios tou anthrōpou
verses.literal: The crowd replied We have heard from the Law that the Christ will remain forever So how can You say that the Son of Man must be lifted up Who is this Son of Man
verses.literalPt: Replicou o povo: Nós ouvimos da Lei que o Cristo permanece para sempre, e como dizes tu ser necessário que o Filho do Homem seja levantado? Quem é esse Filho do Homem?

verses.original: Εἶπεν οὖν αὐτοῖς ὁ Ἰησοῦς Ἔτι μικρὸν χρόνον τὸ φῶς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐστιν περιπατεῖτε ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε ἵνα μὴ σκοτία ὑμᾶς καταλάβῃ καὶ ὁ περιπατῶν ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ οὐκ οἶδεν ποῦ ὑπάγει
verses.transliteration: Eipen oun autois ho Iēsous Eti mikron chronon to phōs en hymin estin peripateite hōs to phōs echete hina mē skotia hymas katalabē kai ho peripatōn en tē skotia ouk oiden pou hypagei
verses.literal: Then Jesus told them For a little while longer the Light will be among you Walk while you have the Light so that darkness will not overtake you The one who walks in the darkness does not know where he is going
verses.literalPt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: Ainda por um pouco, a luz está entre vós. Andai enquanto tendes a luz, para que as trevas não vos apanhem; e quem anda nas trevas não sabe para onde vai.

verses.original: ὡς τὸ φῶς ἔχετε πιστεύετε εἰς τὸ φῶς ἵνα υἱοὶ φωτὸς γένησθε Ταῦτα ἐλάλησεν Ἰησοῦς καὶ ἀπελθὼν ἐκρύβη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: hōs to phōs echete pisteuete eis to phōs hina huioi phōtos genēsthe Tauta elalēsen Iēsous kai apelthōn ekrybē ap’ autōn
verses.literal: While you have the Light believe in the Light so that you may become sons of light After Jesus had spoken these things He went away and was hidden from them
verses.literalPt: Enquanto tendes a luz, crede na luz, para que vos torneis filhos da luz. Assim falou Jesus e, tendo-se retirado, escondeu-se deles.

verses.original: Τοσαῦτα δὲ αὐτοῦ σημεῖα πεποιηκότος ἔμπροσθεν αὐτῶν οὐκ ἐπίστευον εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Tosauta de autou sēmeia pepoiēkotos emprosthen autōn ouk episteuon eis auton
verses.literal: Although Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence . . . they still did not believe in Him
verses.literalPt: Embora tivesse feito tantos milagres na presença deles, não criam nele,

verses.original: ἵνα ὁ λόγος Ἠσαΐου τοῦ προφήτου πληρωθῇ ὃν εἶπεν Κύριε τίς ἐπίστευσεν τῇ ἀκοῇ ἡμῶν καὶ ὁ βραχίων Κυρίου τίνι ἀπεκαλύφθη
verses.transliteration: hina ho logos Ēsaiou tou prophētou plērōthē hon eipen Kyrie tis episteusen tē akoē hēmōn kai ho brachiōn Kyriou tini apekalyphthē
verses.literal: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet - Lord who has believed our message And to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed
verses.literalPt: para que se cumprisse a palavra proferida pelo profeta Isaías: Senhor, quem creu a nossa pregação? E a quem foi revelado o braço do Senhor?

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο οὐκ ἠδύναντο πιστεύειν ὅτι πάλιν εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας
verses.transliteration: Dia touto ouk ēdynanto pisteuein hoti palin eipen Ēsaias
verses.literal: For this reason . . . they were unable . . . to believe For again Isaiah says
verses.literalPt: Não podiam crer, porque, como diz ainda Isaías:

verses.original: Τετύφλωκεν αὐτῶν τοὺς ὀφθαλμοὺς καὶ ἐπώρωσεν αὐτῶν τὴν καρδίαν ἵνα μὴ ἴδωσιν τοῖς ὀφθαλμοῖς καὶ νοήσωσιν τῇ καρδίᾳ καὶ στραφῶσιν καὶ ἰάσομαι αὐτούς
verses.transliteration: Tetyphlōken autōn tous ophthalmous kai epōrōsen autōn tēn kardian hina mē idōsin tois ophthalmois kai noēsōsin tē kardia kai straphōsin kai iasomai autous
verses.literal: He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts so that they cannot see with their eyes and understand with their hearts and turn and I would heal them
verses.literalPt: Cegou-lhes os olhos e endureceu-lhes o coração, para que não vejam com os seus olhos, e entendam no coração, e se convertam, e eu os sare.

verses.original: Ταῦτα εἶπεν Ἠσαΐας ὅτι εἶδεν τὴν δόξαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ἐλάλησεν περὶ αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tauta eipen Ēsaias hoti eiden tēn doxan autou kai elalēsen peri autou
verses.literal: Isaiah said these things because he saw Jesus’ glory and spoke about Him
verses.literalPt: Isso disse Isaías, porque viu a glória dele e dele falou.

verses.original: ὅμως μέντοι καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἀρχόντων πολλοὶ ἐπίστευσαν εἰς αὐτόν ἀλλὰ διὰ τοὺς Φαρισαίους οὐχ ὡμολόγουν ἵνα μὴ ἀποσυνάγωγοι γένωνται
verses.transliteration: homōs mentoi kai ek tōn archontōn polloi episteusan eis auton alla dia tous Pharisaious ouch hōmologoun hina mē aposynagōgoi genōntai
verses.literal: Nevertheless . . . . . . many of the leaders believed in Him But because of the Pharisees they did not confess Him for fear that . . . they would be put out of the synagogue
verses.literalPt: Contudo, muitos das próprias autoridades creram nele, mas, por causa dos fariseus, não o confessavam, para não serem expulsos da sinagoga;

verses.original: ἠγάπησαν γὰρ τὴν δόξαν τῶν ἀνθρώπων μᾶλλον ἤπερ τὴν δόξαν τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ēgapēsan gar tēn doxan tōn anthrōpōn mallon ēper tēn doxan tou Theou
verses.literal: For they loved praise from men more than praise from God
verses.literalPt: porque prezaram mais a glória que vem dos homens do que a glória que vem de Deus.

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ ἔκραξεν καὶ εἶπεν Ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ οὐ πιστεύει εἰς ἐμὲ ἀλλὰ εἰς τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: Iēsous de ekraxen kai eipen Ho pisteuōn eis eme ou pisteuei eis eme alla eis ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: Then Jesus cried out . . . . . . Whoever believes in Me does not believe in Me alone but in the One who sent Me
verses.literalPt: Clamou Jesus, dizendo: Quem crê em mim não crê em mim, mas naquele que me enviou;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ θεωρῶν ἐμὲ θεωρεῖ τὸν πέμψαντά με
verses.transliteration: kai ho theōrōn eme theōrei ton pempsanta me
verses.literal: And whoever sees Me sees the One who sent Me
verses.literalPt: e quem me vê vê aquele que me enviou.

verses.original: ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα ἵνα πᾶς ὁ πιστεύων εἰς ἐμὲ ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ μὴ μείνῃ
verses.transliteration: egō phōs eis ton kosmon elēlytha hina pas ho pisteuōn eis eme en tē skotia mē meinē
verses.literal: I have come into the world as a light so that no one who believes in Me should remain in darkness
verses.literalPt: Eu, que sou a luz, vim ao mundo, a fim de que todo o que crê em mim não permaneça nas trevas.

verses.original: Καὶ ἐάν τίς μου ἀκούσῃ τῶν ῥημάτων καὶ μὴ φυλάξῃ ἐγὼ οὐ κρίνω αὐτόν οὐ γὰρ ἦλθον ἵνα κρίνω τὸν κόσμον ἀλλ’ ἵνα σώσω τὸν κόσμον
verses.transliteration: Kai ean tis mou akousē tōn rhēmatōn kai mē phylaxē egō ou krinō auton ou gar ēlthon hina krinō ton kosmon all’ hina sōsō ton kosmon
verses.literal: As for anyone who hears My words and does not keep them I do not judge him For I have not come to judge the world but to save the world
verses.literalPt: Se alguém ouvir as minhas palavras e não as guardar, eu não o julgo; porque não vim a julgar o mundo, mas a salvar o mundo.

verses.original: ὁ ἀθετῶν ἐμὲ καὶ μὴ λαμβάνων τὰ ῥήματά μου ἔχει τὸν κρίνοντα αὐτόν ὁ λόγος ὃν ἐλάλησα ἐκεῖνος κρινεῖ αὐτὸν ἐν τῇ ἐσχάτῃ ἡμέρᾳ
verses.transliteration: ho athetōn eme kai mē lambanōn ta rhēmata mou echei ton krinonta auton ho logos hon elalēsa ekeinos krinei auton en tē eschatē hēmera
verses.literal: There is a judge for the one who rejects Me and does not receive My words The word that I have spoken will judge him on the last day
verses.literalPt: Quem me despreza e não recebe as minhas palavras tem quem o julgue; a palavra que falei, esta o julgará no último dia.

verses.original: Ὅτι ἐγὼ ἐξ ἐμαυτοῦ οὐκ ἐλάλησα ἀλλ’ ὁ πέμψας με Πατὴρ αὐτός μοι ἐντολὴν δέδωκεν τί εἴπω καὶ τί λαλήσω
verses.transliteration: Hoti egō ex emautou ouk elalēsa all’ ho pempsas me Patēr autos moi entolēn dedōken ti eipō kai ti lalēsō
verses.literal: I have not spoken on My own but the Father who sent Me has commanded Me what to say and how to say it
verses.literalPt: Pois eu por mim mesmo não falei, mas o Pai, que me enviou, este mesmo me tem prescrito o que devo dizer e o que devo falar.

verses.original: καὶ οἶδα ὅτι ἡ ἐντολὴ αὐτοῦ ζωὴ αἰώνιός ἐστιν ἃ οὖν ἐγὼ λαλῶ καθὼς εἴρηκέν μοι ὁ Πατήρ οὕτως λαλῶ
verses.transliteration: kai oida hoti hē entolē autou zōē aiōnios estin ha oun egō lalō kathōs eirēken moi ho Patēr houtōs lalō
verses.literal: And I know that His command leads to eternal life So I speak exactly what the Father has told Me to say
verses.literalPt: Eu sei que o seu mandamento é vida eterna. Aquilo, pois, que eu falo, falo-o como o Pai mo tem dito.
